_doc: Queue of approved, staged blog posts awaiting their publish date. See scheduled/README.md. Each entry's HTML lives at scheduled/<slug>.html and is moved to blog/<slug>.html on its publishDate by the publish-scheduled GitHub Action. After publish, the post's linkedinTeaser is fired to LinkedIn via the direct poster (scripts/fire-linkedin-direct.mjs).

queue.title: Your runway is grading your idea
queue.description: The evidence bar for your idea moves at the speed of your bank balance – and it moves in both directions.
queue.linkedinTeaser: Ten signups at eighteen months of runway is a start. Ten signups at four months suddenly looks like traction. Same ten people – your bank balance is grading your evidence. (Note: teaser step is disabled per the S200 4/week cadence; recorded for the log only.)
